description: Hook points fired by aos-eca-turn (the eca body); tool hooks are in ../mcp/hook_points.json, the loop points in ../hook/loop_points.json.

before_queue.when: turn: every good letter before it is handed to the CLI, slash letters too; also letters that arrive while waiting for the answer

fields.content: the text that will be handed over

before_queue.if_blocked: the letter is closed and dropped; mailbox_warning.txt says which hook dropped it

after_queue.when: the letter was handed to the CLI, joined history and was closed; a failing hook is reported only after the answer is in history

fields.content: the text that was handed over

brain_failed.when: turn: the CLI failed after the letters were handed over

fields.name: error code: CliFailed or ReplyMissing
fields.code: claude only: the same error code
fields.retry: claude only: true when the letters are sent again after a cooldown
fields.attempt: claude only: failures in a row
fields.dropped: claude only: how many letters were dropped
fields.wait_s: claude only, when retry is true: seconds of cooldown
fields.status: claude only, when known: the HTTP status
fields.cause: claude only, when known: the CLI's own failure cause

brain_failed.subject: code

tool_added.when: turn: before each handoff to the CLI, a tool name appeared in this agent's tool registry (the first look only remembers the names)
tool_added.subject: tool

on_clock.when: start of every turn (also turns in a cooldown or that give way): the hook's clock moved on by its own every_cycles / every_ms

fields.first: true right after a start, a wake or a clock change
fields.last_cycle: cycle of the last run, or null
fields.config: the entry's config, when it has one
